styleLock.direction: vintage garment-washed apparel commerce, lived-in retro texture, catalogue-grade fit readability
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio white #FFFFFF for packshots and construction screens, warm ecru paper #EFE6D9 for benefit, comparison and spec screens, weathered matte plaster in the same warm ecru #EFE6D9 family for lifestyle only

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent vintage garment-washed apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless studio white #FFFFFF, warm ecru paper #EFE6D9, charcoal text and rules #2D2D2D and one faded-brick accent #B4614F; warm soft directional daylight from camera-left with a low-contrast skimming component that reveals washed fabric texture and a soft grounding contact shadow; backgrounds limited to seamless studio white, warm ecru paper and weathered matte plaster in the same warm ecru family; one modern geometric sans-serif with generous tracking for all lettering; thin single-weight charcoal leader lines and empty rounded label pills only; garments presented relaxed with natural drape, drop-shoulder seam readable, stable scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no glossy catalog sheen, no invented fabric weights or certifications, no visible brand wordmark or style code.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 男模正面半身无背景实穿、002 背面全身展示落肩与后片长度、003 女模正面 3/4 实穿、004 平铺衣身四条引线工艺标注、005 全身站姿配身高与码数说明、006 整屏色位阵列加两组延伸色板、007 三列分档尺码表、008 三栏染色工艺说明配三件不同衣型。品类判定依据：以图为准，主体为成衣水洗做旧的圆领落肩短袖上衣，短袖针织上衣而非外套或贴身内衣，故归男装/上衣；源平台类目路径仅作参考，源图含女模上身但版型为宽松通码，统一写作 generic adult model 并以颈部以上裁切规避身份。已剥离内容：源图顶部与底部的品牌字标、注册商标符号、款式编号与色板编号、染色工艺子品牌标识与叶形徽标、三位模特面容身份、全部英文说明原句与色名、身高码数具体数值、尺码表内全部胸围数字与单位、可用库存说明句；所有事实位改为空白表格单元、空白圆角标签与留空印章框，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
